description: A straight ramp rising from start (its foot, on the level floor) to end, by default rising the level's floor-to-floor height so it arrives at the floor above, which is then opened over it where headroom (default 2200 mm) would be lost. Default width 3600 (one-way car ramp; two-way ≈ 6100), slab 200 thick, with a 2000 mm half-gradient transition at each end (AS/NZS 2890.1 needs them over 1:8; pass transition 0 for none). The returned gradient is the main slope; residential car ramps up to 1:4 if 20 m or shorter, 1:5 if longer (public 1:5 / 1:6); ramps for people 1:14. To go down to a basement, place it on the lower level, foot at the bottom.
